summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K on July 24, 2026, disclosing a favorable opinion from its Fiscal Council on a proposal to merge four wholly-owned subsidiaries (Tijo Participações e Investimentos S.A., Juno Participações e Investimentos S.A., Retiro Baixo Energética S.A., and Nova Era Janapu Transmissora S.A.) into the parent company. No financial terms (price, premium) are stated; this is an internal corporate reorganization. The merger must be approved by an Extraordinary General Meeting. The filing is routine and does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition, restructuring, or going-private transaction.
